examples.email_subject: Urgent: Update Your Payment Information to Avoid Service Interruption
examples.email_body:
Dear Customer, 

We have updated our payment processing system. Please click the link below to verify and update your payment details to avoid any interruption in your service.

https://trustedvendor-payments-update.com/verify

Thank you for your prompt attention.
TrustedVendor Billing Team

email_headers.Received-SPF: fail (domain of trustedvendor-payments.com does not designate 192.168.1.10 as permitted sender)

indicators: Sender domain does not match the official vendor domain
SPF check fails indicating email sent from unauthorized server
Urgency and threat of service interruption to prompt quick action
Link points to a suspicious domain different from the vendor's official website

examples.email_subject: Action Required: Payment Details Update Needed Immediately
examples.email_body:
Hello,

Our records indicate that your payment information is outdated. Please update your payment details by clicking the link below:

http://trustedvendor-securepayments.com/update

Failure to update your information within 48 hours will result in suspension of your account.

Best regards,
TrustedVendor Accounts Team

email_headers.Received-SPF: pass (domain of trustedvendor.com authorizes sending IP)

indicators: DKIM signature invalid despite SPF passing
DMARC policy fails indicating spoofing attempt
Link URL domain similar but not identical to official vendor domain
Threat of account suspension to create urgency
Sender address uses a plausible but uncommon subdomain
